choreography_timing.observation: The regenerated video contains many of the same general dance elements—airborne jumps, high knee/kick poses, and repeated forward-pointing stances—but they are not aligned frame-for-frame with the source. For example, A begins with an airborne arms-up jump, while B begins in a grounded wide stance with hands near the torso.

Several jump/kick clusters occur at different positions in the sampled chronology: A has a jump sequence around row 2 columns 4-6 and again row 3 column 6, while B places comparable jump/kick poses earlier in row 1 and row 3.
The ending differs: A ends on a running/arm-pump transition pose, while B ends on a forward-pointing stance.

wardrobe.observation: A wears a black fedora in every sampled frame; B has no hat throughout.
A wears dark sunglasses throughout; B has no sunglasses.
The orange-and-black patterned shirt, black shiny pants, and black footwear are broadly preserved.

background.observation: Both videos use a plain light studio background. B appears slightly warmer/off-white and smoother, but the scene is essentially the same.

camera_framing.observation: Both are full-body, static, centered dance shots, but B appears slightly larger/tighter in some frames.
Some edge cropping/positioning differs between corresponding frames, especially during wide jumps and side steps.

retro_low_budget_dance_video_look.observation: The missing fedora and sunglasses noticeably reduce the source's retro dance-video styling.
B has a somewhat cleaner, less accessory-heavy look than A, though it keeps the plain studio setup and bold patterned shirt.
Temporal mismatch in the contact sheet weakens the impression of recreating the same low-budget choreography clip.

uncertainty_due_to_sampled_frames: Moderate. The contact sheets sample frames every 1/6 second, so small in-between motion differences cannot be assessed. However, the missing hat and sunglasses are visible in every sampled B frame, and the choreography/timing offsets are observable across many sampled frames.
